personality: 3 Editorial structure with 6 Glass / Luxe surfaces
personality_one_liner: A cinematic, reader-focused sanctuary that seamlessly shifts between a warm, tactile bookish light mode and a deep, immersive glass-luxe dark mode.

spacing.rule: Generous editorial spacing in Light mode; tight cinematic precision in Dark. Never cramp metadata.

do's: Use blur on the persistent mini-player.
Use blur on the tab bar.
Use blur on bottom sheets and modal overlays in Dark Mode.
Overlay glass controls on the full-screen audio player.
dont's: Don't use glass on regular list items or standard cards.
Don't stack glass on top of glass.
Avoid glass in Light mode on data-dense screens; reserve it for Dark mode luxe moments.

screens.name: Home
screens.purpose: Discover new audiobooks and immediately resume playback.

states.empty: No items? Show a stylized illustration inviting users to Explore.
states.error: Readable text with retry button inside a centered flex container.

screens.layout: Header with 'LightListen' wordmark (Playfair Display) and Avatar. Horizontal scroll (padding horizontal lg) for 'Continue Listening' showing large hero cards with progress bars. Below, vertical lists or 2-col grids for 'New This Week' and 'Popular'. End with a glass-tinted banner previewing 'Community Requests'.

screens.name: Explore
screens.purpose: Search and filter the curated catalog.

states.empty: No results for search query. Illustration + 'Try a different keyword'.

screens.layout: Sticky search bar at the top (surfaceTertiary bg). Scrollable row of pill-shaped genre filters beneath. 2-col grid for novel results. Ensure bottom padding accounts for the sticky mini-player.

screens.name: Novel Detail
screens.purpose: Display novel metadata, volumes, and chapter tracklist.

states.loading: Cover skeleton and line skeletons for metadata.

screens.layout: Hero image at top with a vertical gradient scrim (transparent to surface). Large Playfair Display title and Satoshi author name on top of the scrim. A sticky Primary CTA button ('Play Chapter 1') that docks below the header on scroll. Below, horizontal volume tabs, followed by a vertical list of chapters. Each chapter row includes chapter number, duration, and a download icon button.

screens.name: Audio Player (Fullscreen)

states.loading: Buffering spinner inside the play button.

screens.layout: Full screen modal. Large centered square artwork. Title and author text. A fluid, thick scrub bar. Playback controls grouped tightly (speed, prev, play/pause, next, sleep timer). Use an atmospheric blurred background derived from the cover art (expo-image blurRadius).

screens.name: Library
screens.purpose: Manage user's personal collection and downloads.

states.empty: Illustration + 'Your library is empty. Start exploring!'

screens.layout: Top material-style tabs (Continue, Saved, Downloads). List layout for items. The 'Downloads' tab must display local storage sizes (e.g., '120 MB') and trash icon actions to delete.

screens.name: Community Requests
screens.purpose: Allow users to request and vote on new novels.

states.empty: No requests found for query. Prompt to 'Create New Request'.

screens.layout: Search input at top. List of existing requests (Title + vote count + status badge). Status badges use structural colors (success, warning, info) with subtle background tints. Add a floating action button (FAB) for 'New Request'.

screens.name: Profile
screens.purpose: Account settings, storage management, and theme configuration.
screens.layout: List of setting rows. Prominent 'Theme Switcher' segmented control (Light Bookish / Dark Cinematic). Storage management section showing a progress bar of used space. A visually distinct 'Pro' banner (Coming Soon) using brand gradients or glass to look premium. Logout button at bottom.

instructions_to_main_agent: IMPLEMENT THEME SWITCHING: The user explicitly requested two distinct themes ('Light, warm bookish' and 'Dark, cinematic reader-focused'). Use the standard `color` properties for Light mode and the `dark_*` properties for Dark mode. Build a ThemeProvider that toggles these.

PERSISTENT MINI-PLAYER: Must sit above the bottom navigation tabs across Home, Explore, and Library. Use `expo-blur` for its background to create a glass effect. Ensure underlying scroll views (lists/grids) have bottom padding so the last item isn't hidden by the mini-player.
AUDIO PLAYER: Use `expo-audio`. Build a dedicated full-screen modal that opens when the mini-player is tapped. This modal should feature large artwork with a blurred backdrop of the artwork.
FONT HIERARCHY: Use 'Playfair Display' for high-impact titles (novel titles, screen headers) and 'Satoshi' for body text, metadata, buttons, and chapter lists.
MOCK IMAGES: Use the provided Pexels links in the `images` object for sample novel covers in the MVP to simulate a real catalog.

SCRIM GRADIENT: Any text overlaid on cover images (like the Novel Detail hero section) MUST have a vertical gradient scrim behind it (transparent at top, 70-100% surface at bottom) to ensure WCAG text contrast.
HAPTICS: Implement haptic feedback per the `haptics` object above. The interactions on the audio player (play, pause, seek) should feel tactile.
